blockers.name: Brocade runners
blockers.reason: Searches across Pexels, Unsplash, Pixabay, Wikimedia Commons, museum open collections and commercial product sources did not verify a suitable reuse-cleared brocade table runner photograph. Commercial exact product images have no reuse permission; generic shiny runners do not establish brocade construction. Museum brocade textiles without runner identity are not suitable substitutes.

further_museum_research.result: 42 matches inspected; only material-verified, photographed CC0 table runner is accession 1939.145. Other matches are copyrighted lace table-setting components without images.

575 metadata matches inspected for runner/table identity. Three photographed table covers exist, but measurements and museum titles establish covers rather than runners: 1916.1377 (108×72.5cm), 1939.149 (101.6×84.5cm), 1939.152 (170.2×102.2cm). No substitution made.
All 36 search records fetched. Three actual runner titles: object 229482 mixed wool/chenille/metal/silk embroidered runner; 229671 and 229673 linen needle-lace runners. No brocade runner.

All 134 bitmap file metadata records fetched and checked for brocade/silk. No brocade runner identified in licensed metadata. Auckland silk AM11338 photograph visually rejected for staining; other silk runner is unusual cross-shaped satin with crocheted pansies; Cleveland 1939.145 remains the best conventional silk runner.
LACMA table runner search identified a linen plain-weave embroidered runner; not silk/brocade.
Silk table runner photo marked Creative Commons-BY but original image is black and white, inferior to the clear color Cleveland runner. No brocade construction verified.
Dallas Gold, White and Pink Table Runner is open-access, but published object metadata does not identify brocade construction; cannot infer material from name or color.
Explicit silk/brocade table runner or door curtain, but no affirmative commercial reuse license; reproduction marked No.
Explicit satin/brocade temple runner but museum photo credited Beth Mann, no reuse permission verified, and temple use differs from dining rental.
